pipelines.name: Fab split, await child processing, merge back

steps.name: Invoke fab-split v1 into the child lot
Await the bounded durable child plan
Invoke fab-merge v1 with the durable child result

definition.name: Split a frozen wafer set into a child Lot

invariants: Frozen manifest and wafer identities are conserved
payload.purpose: Move an identified frozen set from source Lot to a pre-created target child Lot.

definition.name: Merge a completed child Lot back into its parent

invariants: Frozen manifest and wafer identities are conserved
payload.purpose: Move the exact frozen child wafer set to its parent under a separate transaction identity. This static example is not multi-source expansion.
